interface.signature: N, M, X, Y, A -> int

preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix must be within the specified range.
The target coordinates (X, Y) must be within the bounds of the matrix.
The starting cell (0,0) must contain a 1 to allow movement.

postconditions.description: If the starting cell is 0, return -1; otherwise, return a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(A[x][y] == 1 for x in range(N) for y in range(M)) else return_value >= 0
postconditions.description: If there are no reachable cells containing 1, return -1; otherwise, return a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not (0 <= X < N and 0 <= Y < M) else return_value >= 0
postconditions.description: If the target coordinates are out of bounds, return -1; otherwise, return a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps.
